# BYZ scope, monthly (main-line scheduler oe_ml_monthly, gen_mainline_lock.py).
oe_mo_monthly = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_mo_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    # A despot of the Morea from another house: hold back the generic vacancy event oe_ti.31 (oe_mo.3 takes it).
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_mo_hold_heir = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_ti_heir_open months = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_mo_due_3 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mo.3 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_mo_due_7 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mo.7 }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_mo_due_12 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mo.12 }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_ml_free = yes oe_mo_base = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 0 oe_mo_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_mo_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 0 oe_mo_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_mo_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 0 oe_mo_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_mo_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 0 oe_mo_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_mo_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 0 oe_mo_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_mo_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 0 oe_mo_open_8 = yes } random = { chance = oe_mo_ch_8 set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 8 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 0 oe_mo_open_9 = yes } random = { chance = oe_mo_ch_9 set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 9 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 0 oe_mo_open_10 = yes } random = { chance = oe_mo_ch_10 set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 10 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 0 oe_mo_open_11 = yes } random = { chance = oe_mo_ch_11 set_variable = { name = oe_mo_pick value = 11 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 1 } oe_mo_fire = { n = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 2 } oe_mo_fire = { n = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 4 } oe_mo_fire = { n = 4 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 5 } oe_mo_fire = { n = 5 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 6 } oe_mo_fire = { n = 6 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 8 } oe_mo_fire = { n = 8 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 9 } oe_mo_fire = { n = 9 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 10 } oe_mo_fire = { n = 10 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_mo_pick = 11 } oe_mo_fire = { n = 11 } }
        remove_variable = oe_mo_pick
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends a scheduled event; a one-off event is marked done first.
oe_mo_fire = {
    set_variable = oe_mo_done_$n$
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mo.$n$
}

# Any scope. Imperial Authority $amount$ (negative = a cost).
oe_mo_auth = { if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } } } }

# BYZ scope. Every theme of region 14 gains or loses loyalty (recent-events term of the loyalty target).
oe_mo_theme_loy = { every_subject = { limit = { oe_mo_theme_14 = yes } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ } } }

# BYZ scope. Every location of ours in region 14 gets location modifier $mod$ for $years$ years.
oe_mo_region_mod = {
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 14 }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $years$ mode = replace }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_mo_cand set. oe_mo.1 a: the Despotate of the Morea. Uses region 14's theme if there is one,
# otherwise founds it with its seat at Mistra (the region centre Corinth is Latin in 1337), then makes it a despotate
# with oe_ti_install_despot (oe_ti_grant_despotate_do would charge again and fire oe_ti.30).
oe_mo_create_despotate = {
    if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { oe_mo_theme_14 = yes } }
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_mo_theme_14 = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_theme }
    }
    else = {
        location:mystras = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_seat }
        oe_theme_found_at_seat = yes
        # decision 194 (r17): the new theme is inactive until recalculated; the despot cannot move into it before
        force_recalc_country_active_status = scope:target_building_country
        scope:target_building_country = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_distance value = 3 }
            save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_theme
        }
    }
    scope:oe_mo_cand = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_char set_variable = oe_mo_morea_despot }
    oe_ti_install_despot = yes
    set_global_variable = oe_mo_despotate
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_mo_theme and scope:oe_mo_cand set. oe_mo.3 a: an imperial prince takes over the Morea.
oe_mo_prince_takes_over = {
    scope:oe_mo_theme = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_theme }
    scope:oe_mo_cand = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_char set_variable = oe_mo_morea_despot }
    oe_ti_install_despot = yes
    scope:oe_mo_theme = {
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -15 }
        random = { chance = 20 set_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_mo.6: the Hexamilion is rebuilt at Corinth (as vanilla flavor_byz.38 a does).
oe_mo_build_wall = {
    unlock_building_effect = { type = hexamilion_wall }
    location:corinth = { construct_building = { building_type = building_type:hexamilion_wall } }
    set_global_variable = oe_mo_hexamilion
}
